Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class GameMap

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.GameMap
public class GameMap extends Object
A rectangular tile grid parsed from text. Legend: # wall, . pellet, o power pellet, P player start, G ghost pen tile, - pen door, space = empty.
